## GitHub Settings

### Recommended Labels

| Label | Color | Use For |
|---|---|---|
| `bug` | `#d73a4a` | Something is broken |
| `enhancement` | `#a2eeef` | New feature or request |
| `documentation` | `#0075ca` | Docs improvements |
| `good first issue` | `#7057ff` | Welcome for newcomers |
| `help wanted` | `#008672` | Community help needed |
| `security` | `#ff7619` | Security-related |
| `epic` | `#3e4b9e` | Large multi-story work |
| `governance` | `#6f42c1` | Policy, compliance, ADR |

### Social Preview

Upload `public/readme/readme-hero.png` or create a new 1280x640 social preview image in GitHub repository settings.
